source: ZTE ZXHN H267A TRT29 radio profile defaults, sanitized for source distribution.
sanitization: SSID1, APCLI SSID and WPA keys are generic placeholders replaced from current GUI settings by wireless-bridge.sh.
MacAddress is intentionally empty; no device MAC address is included.
APCLI BSSID is zero and HideSSID is disabled.
private_packaging_requirement: Fill each MacAddress with your own stock radio MAC before packing to reproduce the native-tested profile form.
native_validation_limit: Empty-profile MAC fallback is inferred from the new 2.4 GHz source; blank-profile behavior of the legacy 5 GHz module is untested.
retained_defaults: Other radio settings remain vendor defaults, including the unused WPA2-PSK profile own_ip_addr default; these are not captures of an upstream network.
